trigger: Checkout flow execution, shopping cart total recalculation, or order review

database_interactions.condition: Retrieve order details when calculating totals for an existing order
Retrieve line items to sum up unit prices and quantities
Retrieve tax, shipping, and discount adjustments associated with the order

business_rules_sequence: Calculate subtotal by summing line item amounts (quantity multiplied by unit price).
Retrieve and apply item-level and order-level promotional discounts.
Calculate total sales tax applicable to taxable items and shipping.
Calculate shipping charges and handling fees.
Sum subtotal, shipping fees, and taxes, then subtract discounts to determine the final grand total.
